evidence.title: Permitted Use Text Amendments: Crypto Currency, Data Centers, and Government Protection Services
evidence.supports: Shows 'Data Centers' were addressed only in a later, separate proposed UDO text amendment package (Nov. 2024), not as part of the cryptocurrency-mining moratorium itself.
evidence.quote: The purpose of the proposed text amendments will be to address the following uses in the Buncombe County Zoning Ordinance: • Cryptocurrency Mining Operations • Data Centers • Government Protective

decisions.notes: SECTOR_CHECK: the operative ordinance (23-05-05) and its 2024 extension (24-05-09) are both titled and scoped to cryptocurrency mining facilities only. 'Data center' appears only in a later, separate proposed permitted-use text amendment package (a distinct, still-pending instrument per the process rule that a separate instrument does not count), so sectors correctly remains ["cryptocurrency_mining"].

sectors.reason: SECTOR_CHECK: the operative ordinance's Section 1 definitional list of covered 'high impact industries and/or facilities' includes a distinct data-center-type use ('Unenclosed data storage facilities utilizing any powered cooling devices') alongside the cryptocurrency-mining definition, so data centers were part of the moratorium's operative scope, not merely a trigger mention.
